name: Trans-synaptic adhesion complexes in synaptic membrane assembly
rationale: Members cover neurexin-neuroligin, SALM and receptor phosphatase adhesion molecules organizing pre- and postsynaptic membranes and PSD-95/NMDA receptor clustering, whereas confusables center on regulation of synapse assembly or postsynaptic potential and inhibitory receptor clustering.

name: Inhibitory glycinergic neurotransmission in sensory and respiratory control
rationale: Members share inhibitory glycine/GABA signalling (glycinergic transmission, SLC6A5 hyperekplexia, MECP2-GABA genes, dampened nerve impulse transmission) applied to touch and breathing, unlike confusables about locomotor behavior or GABA synthesis and reuptake.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Zinc, copper and manganese ion transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members cover transmembrane transport, homeostasis and detoxification of zinc (SLC39/SLC30), copper, manganese, cadmium and cobalt, distinguishing them from iron/heme-handling and MTF1 metal-response confusables.

name: Mitochondrial protein import, processing and membrane organization
rationale: Members concern import, processing and degradation of mitochondrial proteins plus cristae, outer membrane, fusion and calcium/RNA import, unlike confusables on mitophagy and fission/fusion regulation or respiratory complex assembly.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and muscle development
rationale: Members are DAG1 O-mannosyl/matriglycan glycosylation and its dystroglycanopathy defects plus skeletal muscle and diaphragm development, distinguishing them from DGC/basement membrane and other proteoglycan glycosylation confusables.

name: Corticotropin and glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: All three members are stimulation of HPA-axis hormone secretion (ACTH, glucocorticoid, cortisol), whereas confusables concern responses to stress hormones or feeding-related secretion.

name: Procaspase-8 activation and c-FLIP inhibition in TRAIL signaling
rationale: Members describe caspase-8 dimerization and its inhibition by c-FLIP downstream of TRAIL receptors, distinct from Fas/BID, necroptosis and broad extrinsic apoptosis confusables.

name: Cadherin adherens junction assembly and E-cadherin turnover
rationale: Members cover calcium-dependent cadherin cell-cell adhesion, adherens junction assembly, CDH11 interactions and CDH1 trafficking, degradation and apoptotic cleavage, unlike confusables focused on EMT and regulation of cadherin adhesion.

name: Xenobiotic biotransformation by oxidation, methylation, acetylation and sulfonation
rationale: Members are CYP/FMO oxidation, ethanol oxidation, methylation, acetylation and sulfonation of drugs and toxins under AhR control, whereas confusables emphasize aldehyde detoxification or drug transport and glucuronidation.

qualifier: de novo synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
name: De novo glycerophospholipid synthesis and intermembrane lipid transfer
rationale: Members cover synthesis of PC, PE, PS, PI, PG, cardiolipin and plasmalogens plus non-vesicular lipid transfer (including ABCA4/A2E retinal lipid handling), distinct from acyl-chain remodeling and sphingolipid confusables.

core: Choline supply and high-energy phosphate metabolism
name: Choline uptake and phosphocreatine energy buffering
rationale: Members split between choline provision (SLC5A7 uptake, acetylcholine metabolism, lysophospholipid hydrolysis) and energy-phosphate handling (creatine/phosphocreatine, mitochondrial ATP/ADP transport, pyrophosphate hydrolysis), the latter absent from cholinergic and choline-catabolism confusables.

name: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation and mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: Members are lysosomal breakdown of heparan, chondroitin/dermatan, keratan sulfate and hyaluronan and the MPS disorders (plus sialidosis), unlike confusables on GAG biosynthesis or glycosphingolipid catabolism.

name: Sulfate and oxalate anion exchange transport
rationale: All members concern SLC26-type exchange of sulfate and oxalate, distinguishing them from bicarbonate and organic anion transporter confusables.

name: Desmosome assembly in cardiomyocyte cell-cell adhesion
rationale: Members cover desmosome and intermediate filament assembly, junctional protein localization and cardiomyocyte adhesion and action potential, unlike epithelial adherens junction and hemidesmosome confusables.

name: Bicarbonate transport in enamel mineralization and tooth eruption
rationale: Members share SLC4 bicarbonate transport (with its renal acidosis defects) and ion transport for enamel mineralization and tooth eruption, the dental context absent from SLC26 anion-exchange and pH confusables.

name: PALB2-BRCA2 dependent homologous recombination and D-loop resolution
rationale: Members are PALB2-BRCA1/BRCA2 defects in homology-directed repair and SDSA resolution of D-loops, distinct from end resection, single-strand annealing and BRCA1/BARD1 damage-response confusables.

name: Cystine-glutamate exchange and glutathione turnover in ferroptosis suppression
rationale: Members cover cystine import, glutamate homeostasis, cysteine metabolism, glutathione transport and catabolism and inhibition of ferroptosis, unlike confusables on glutathione synthesis defects or general ROS detoxification.

name: Integrin-fibronectin adhesion driving mesenchymal cell migration and spreading
rationale: Members span integrin and syndecan interactions, fibronectin matrix, focal adhesion and stress fiber assembly and an EMT/fibroblast migration program, distinct from MET-PTK2 signaling and pure ECM-composition confusables.

qualifier: follicle growth, ovulation and luteal phase
name: Ovarian follicle growth, ovulation and corpus luteum cycle
rationale: Members cover antral follicle development, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis, estrous cycle and gonadotropin feedback, unlike confusables on oocyte maturation, testis development or progesterone synthesis.

qualifier: Th2 cytokines, mast cells and eosinophils
name: Th2-driven allergic immunity via mast cells and eosinophils
rationale: Members are Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13/33 signaling, FcεRI mast cell activation, IgE switching and eosinophil function, distinguishing them from other interleukin/JAK-STAT, Th17 and Fc-gamma/BCR confusables.

qualifier: vascular smooth muscle constriction and relaxation
name: Vasoconstriction and vasorelaxation control of arterial blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate systemic and pulmonary pressure through vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation (catecholamines, endothelin, cGMP), unlike renin-angiotensin, NO production and generic smooth muscle confusables.

name: Vascular wound healing and blood vessel remodeling
rationale: Members regulate vascular wound healing, vessel remodeling, endothelial apoptosis and smooth muscle adaptation, whereas confusables address smooth muscle migration/phenotypic switching or angiogenic sprouting.

qualifier: nucleotide-sugar and dolichol pathways in congenital glycosylation disorders
name: Nucleotide-sugar and dolichol precursor synthesis in congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: Members cover nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport, dolichol-linked oligosaccharide and GPI assembly, N-glycan processing and their CDG defects, unlike confusables on glycan elongation, GAG synthesis or lysosomal glycolipid catabolism.

qualifier: Rho GTPase and ILK signaling with SRF targets
name: Rho GTPase and ILK-driven actin remodeling with SRF targets
rationale: Members are ROCK/PAK activation, ILK-PINCH-parvin focal adhesion signaling, stress fiber assembly and SRF-target cytoskeletal gene modules, distinct from integrin-matrix migration and platelet activation confusables.

name: Endosomal receptor recycling to the plasma membrane
rationale: Members concern endocytic uptake, endosome organization and recycling of receptors back to the cell surface, unlike confusables on receptor internalization, Golgi-endosome transport or synaptic receptor trafficking.
